scope: ANLI three-way inference; fallback scale and optional positive-gain routing; quality collection sequentially on a single GPU

data.duplicates: exclude contradictory training input groups; same-label duplicates retain lexicographically first uid; preserve all official test
data.holdout: All 3200 official test examples across R1/R2/R3; never select rounds using scores
data.grouping: Normalized premise SHA256; no premise overlap between development, calibration, validation or holdout
data.sampling: Deterministic hash order, whole-premise role assignment before within-role per-round/class subsampling; training candidates exclude test premises and normalized inputs
data.inputs: Only premise and hypothesis, fixed label descriptions; never reason, gold or adversarial metadata
data.target: Question-weighted accuracy on the complete official test pool; R1/R2/R3 reported separately as descriptive results
data.contamination: Project-unseen task, not a claim of pretraining-unseen data

policies.fit: Separate regularized local/fallback correctness logistic regressions; calibration only; fixed L2; standardized using calibration statistics only
policies.threshold: Descending complete score-tie groups; largest validation count not above 10% budget; no holdout top-k
policies.positive_gain: Only score strictly greater than zero is eligible; leave budget unused; if none eligible freeze no-deferral; runtime local failure still forces deferral
policies.selection: No validation-driven choice of primary model, policy, task round or hyperparameters
policies.actual_budget: Report observed holdout deferral; frozen policies may consume different actual budgets

evaluation.primary: Accuracy(positive_gain with Qwen9B fallback) minus accuracy(confidence with Qwen9B fallback)
evaluation.weighting: Question-weighted pooled accuracy; resample complete premise clusters with replacement, retaining cross-round grouping
evaluation.secondary: Direct model accuracies, all frozen policies with both fallbacks, round-level outcomes, rescue/harm, failures, actual deferral and oracle complementarity are descriptive; no unadjusted multi-comparison significance claims
evaluation.holdout_access: All fit and holdout jobs complete, policy freeze validated, and immutable first-access receipt written before parsing holdout gold
evaluation.reuse: No v1/v2 evaluation data for prospective v3 model or policy selection; no retuning after first v3 evaluation

stopping.technical: Stop on exact-token preflight failure, smoke failure, model/runtime identity mismatch or more than 1% terminal runtime errors after 50 new inputs
stopping.quality: Do not stop, replace models or alter thresholds based on holdout accuracy; no guarantee of improvement
stopping.session: Bind the actual allocation and observed remaining time; resume stored shards without renewing the same allocation deadline

performance.this_round: Record per-request serial collection latency and device/resource provenance only; not a steady-state/cascade benchmark
performance.next_stage: Real co-resident 9B cascade feasibility and longer open-arrival measurements require a separately frozen configuration after development-only feasibility checks
